items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020

ctx.x: You know you nailed it because let me tell you something. Everything I’ve done in my life, and I have a pretty wide scope of music from Louis to Charlie Parker, Miles — it all, the foundation of all of it is Louis’ time. And not just for me. I heard an interview from a documentary of Bing Crosby. And Bing said me, I wouldn’t be here and Sinatra wouldn’t be here if it wasn’t for Louis. And I did a gig with, oh my God, the saxophone player who, from the 20s was in the Paul Whiteman band, you would know him, he was…
Before, no before Lester Young, Bud Freeman.
